description: This PHP source file defines a model class `CompletedPerformanceReviewModel` for representing completed performance review data within the OrangeHRM performance module API. It implements the `Normalizable` interface and uses traits and methods to serialize performance review entities for API responses, including properties like job title, subunit, review period, status, ratings, comments, and completion date.

classes.description: A model class for serializing completed performance review data for API responses, implementing filtering and attribute naming for serialization.
